query: what are the instruments in a woodwind quintet
passage: Which instruments are part of the woodwind section of an orchestra? Woodwind instruments are instruments that used to be made of wood. These include the flute, piccolo, oboe, english horn, clarinet, and bassoon. This is in order from highest to lowest sounding instrument.
